Maya (CS): Heads-up — Lumina Health (acct: LUM-001) showing a ~78% drop in total embeddings + generation calls starting 2026-03-10. Renewal is 2026-05-15. New ML lead (Ilya) joined 3/1 and procurement mentioned a pilot with RivalAI. We should triage ASAP.
Diego (AM): Thanks Maya. Can you drop the query results? I'll ping Ilya and the procurement contact.
Maya (CS): Pasting quick usage snap from analytics:
```sql
-- daily tokens and calls for client_id = 'LUM-001'
SELECT date, sum(tokens) as tokens, sum(calls) as calls
FROM api_usage
WHERE client_id='LUM-001' AND date >= '2026-02-20'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
-- result: 2026-03-09 calls=8,432 tokens=1.2M; 2026-03-10 calls=1,900 tokens=210k; 2026-03-11 calls=1,100 tokens=120k
```
Maya (CS): No obvious 401s in quick scan, but saw more retries on 3/10.
Evan (Solutions): I can run a short check for elevated latency/errors and recent config changes. Putting a quick grep on the request logs for LUM-001 now.
analytics-bot: Auto-report — top anomalies for LUM-001: calls drop (78%), avg latency +12ms on 3/10, error-rate spike from 0.2% -> 1.8% on 3/10.
Diego (AM): Probable causes: new ML lead pivoting to RivalAI, accidental credential rotation, or a perf regression. I'll DM Ilya to see if they're intentionally reducing traffic.
Marta (Onboarding): If they want help with tuning or prompt engineering for embeddings, I can offer a 30-min session this week. Wed or Thu morning PT work for me.
Linh (CSM Manager): Assigning owners: Diego = outreach/exec contact, Maya = technical triage + logs, Evan = infra check, Marta = enablement session. If RivalAI is on a pilot, we should offer a short dedicated perf comparison and a 2-week extension on their trial to run it.
Maya (CS): Draft outreach note for Diego — short, non-salesy, offer help + quick win:
"Hi Ilya — noticed usage dip beginning 3/10; wanted to check if this was expected. If you're evaluating alternatives, happy to set up a 30-min tune + perf check and extend your trial for 2 weeks so you can run comparisons with the exact prompts/workloads. No strings. — Maya"
Diego (AM): Sending now. Will report back within the hour. @Marta can you block Wed 10am PT as provisional?
Marta (Onboarding): Blocked Wed 10am PT. Tentative invite ready.
Evan (Solutions): Quick infra update: no config rollouts affecting LUM-001 on 3/9-3/11. Found increased 5xx retries from a small subset of keys tied to a mobile ingestion pipeline — investigating whether client switched to a batched flow that trips a timeout. Will post logs in thread.
Maya (CS): Good catch. If they moved to batching, we should suggest batch-size tuning + KV cache settings; that often reduces token costs and keeps latency predictable.
Linh (CSM Manager): If Diego confirms competitive eval, we'll prepare a 1-pager comparison (latency/cost/examples) and ask Research for a quick bench on their representative prompt set. Evan, can you help with bench once we have sample prompts?
Evan (Solutions): Yep. If they share a representative prompt or dataset, I can run a head-to-head using our standard perf harness.
analytics-bot: Created ticket #CS-7829: "Lumina Health usage drop — triage + enablement" and scheduled a reminder for renewal watch on 2026-05-01.
Diego (AM): Update: Ilya replied — they're running a parallel pilot with RivalAI, paused some pipelines while they compare costs. They asked if we can show token-cost estimates and a small perf comparison on their actual prompts.
Maya (CS): Plan of attack: 1) Marta runs enablement Wed 10am PT (offer prompt tuning). 2) Evan + Research bench on sample prompts (Diego to request). 3) Offer 2-week trial extension + canary capacity if they need throughput. 4) Follow-up with procurement to understand contract timing.
Marta (Onboarding): I'll prepare a short enablement deck + quick checklist for the session.
Linh (CSM Manager): Great — please capture next actions in #CS-7829. Diego, escalate to Solutions if they want an exec perf demo.
Diego (AM): Will do. Thanks team :thumbsup:
Maya (CS): I'll monitor logs and update thread if I see anything else.
Evan (Solutions): Posting initial grep results in 15m.
Marta (Onboarding): Invite sent to Ilya & procurement.
Diego (AM): Marking owner -> Diego (outreach), Maya (tech), Evan (bench), Marta (enablement). Will check back after Wed session.
Linh (CSM Manager): Thanks all. Let's aim to have the bench + cost comparison before Fri EOD so we can influence procurement. :calendar:
